name: kestrel-nest-client
description: Browser layer for the Nest server: frameworkless TS scripts rendered against its templates
//: Both commands run from this directory: vite discovers vite.config.mts here, and the config anchors every path (including ../../public, the asset directory both servers serve) at import.meta.dirname. The Rust -> WASM client lives in the sibling Rust stack (rust/client/), which is a Cargo package, not a pnpm one; nothing here builds it.
